notes.title: Major Update (Final Update Pt. 1/2)
notes.notes:
Major Update (Final Update Pt. 1/2) 
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Here's a quick rundown for this update. ːaliencreatureː

[list]
    [*]Around 120 new achievements added.
    [*]Stat fixes. (Not really that much, just some nerfs.)
    [*]Spawn Rate Fixes (Spawn rates have been greatly decreased)
    [*]All default sprites replaced.
    [*]New enemies, bosses, and attacks.
[/list]

Major Update (Final Update Pt. 2/2) Releasing soon.
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Pt. 2 of the update will include only one thing. It will include a new button that I know you will all love... ;) 

It will also include a new achievement.



EDIT: Citadel bug HAS NOT been fixed. I would advise not playing the game until I make an announcement. (Unless you haven't gotten that far.)

(Thank you [t]™ for the suggestion.)

notes.title: Small New Update, Major one coming very, very soon.
notes.notes:
Hey, so the update you are about to have ISN'T the major update coming in a few days. I was testing the achievements to see if they worked, and the update made sure the first achievement worked. If you check, just starting a new game gives you an achievement. There is also an options menu with game settings. 

UPCOMING UPDATE:
-Stat Fixes
-Spawn Rate fixes
-Stat Fixes
-Default sprites removed
-Character Changes
-Enemy changes
-Attack Nerfs
-Many new achievements

*Note: This will probably be the last update. I understand you all hate this game. It's a casual game made in 2 weeks. I get it. So I'll stop. I'm going to Unreal Engine with C++ now so you guys can all chill. 

See you soon!
